positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked as a full-stack engineer for a startup creating an online portfolio platform for software developers. Deployed new features to production weekly, utilizing React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, & Mongoose.

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description: Foster inclusive community on floor and throughout Couzens Residence Hall. Includes offering support for all residents and duties at the Community Center.

positions.title: Community Assistant
positions.description: Supported students, staff and visitors in the residential community by addressing needs at the community center in Couzens Hall, as well as handle room key, package, and mail distribution.

positions.title: Photographer
positions.description: Variety of photography experience, from paid photography of 2011 Kerrytown Bookfestival (photo used in the Detroit News),  to capturing high school prom for local news source, to starting a service to take senior pictures for free.

positions.title: Early Learner Tutor

volunteerExperiences.description: Play cheerful songs for children and families at the Mott's Children's Hospital at the University of Michigan, the Ann Arbor District Libraries, and local senior homes.
